{{Infobox map |name=bancedm1 |year=2024 |image=Bancedm1_1.png |creator={{player|Bance|flag=us}} |gametype=1on1 2on2 |size=small |download=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Jli2vpHZ7h6tbHRGHM-Qcy7uhJ2YLefm/view?usp=sharing |loc= }} '''bancedm1''' is a map created by {{player|Bance|flag=us}} originally for a half-life mod he was working on. After joining the QuakeWorld community he made several modifications to the map for release in QuakeWorld. Bancedm1 takes on a style similar to classic dm maps particularly dm2 for theme and more sneaky/tactical gameplay in 1on1. It also contains a unique twist for 2on2 with the inclusion of the ring along with the quad. Currently up in beta on:
anyother.ohioqw.com:28501
